parsed.explanation: The quote is verbatim from the Xiang Yu guarantee in Lemma 1.1. Turns alternate with LB first, so after LB takes $p_j$ and XY takes $\ell$, the next move is LB's: LB moves first on $M''$ (the LB part of the same proof correctly says 'on which LB moves first'). The induction hypothesis gives the mover who plays first $\operatorname{odd}$ and the second player $\operatorname{even}$, so XY is entitled only to $\operatorname{even}(M'')$, not $\operatorname{odd}(M'')$; the stated inference is invalid. The lemma is true and repairable ($j=1$: $p_2+\operatorname{even}(M'')=\operatorname{even}(M)$; $j\ge2$: $p_1+\operatorname{even}(M'')\ge\operatorname{even}(M)$ via consecutive differences), but this repair appears nowhere in the text, and Lemma 1.1 underpins the reduction to alternating sums, so the proof is invalid as written.
